phase1.assumption: Deterministic methods can fully and accurately synthesize reports without requiring probabilistic or contextual elements.
phase1.inversion: Deterministic methods are inherently limited and cannot account for the complexity, ambiguity, or contextual nuances required for accurate report synthesis.
predictions: Reports generated using deterministic methods will show 100% consistency across multiple runs.
Human reviewers will rate deterministic reports as accurate 95% of the time compared to probabilistic methods.
The time taken to synthesize a report using deterministic methods will be 40% faster than probabilistic methods.
